evals.prompt: Render a social card for sample-appstoreconnect. Keep its full name and summary readable.
evals.expected_output: Try a single-line title from maximum down to the stated minimum; use balanced separator boundaries only when necessary. Never leave a dangling hyphen or split arbitrary letters.

evals.prompt: Render our social preview using this accepted PNG app icon, then check that the exported card is current.
evals.expected_output: Render a 1280×640 RGBA PNG from the supplied DESIGN, catalog and accepted icon with the pinned WebAssembly rasterizer. Accept square PNG, JPEG and WebP inputs at or above DESIGN's icon size; fully decode still images using WebAssembly. Reject APNG and animated WebP, including SVG embeddings, with the icon file named. SVGs retain only allowlisted SVG-namespace elements, attributes and value functions, and drop metadata contents. Only use accepts fragment links; only image accepts matching raster base64 data links. Reject foreign namespaces, unknown elements or attributes, styles, animation, non-fragment url() values, DOCTYPE/entity declarations and processing instructions at every depth. Real app PNG and generated framework SVG icons still render without clipping. Repeated renders and social-preview check are deterministic; pixel drift fails check without writing exports. Return the PNG and validation results.

evals.prompt: Lay out the README of example-team/parcel-app, an open-source macOS app shipped as a notarized DMG and a Homebrew cask, with a bundled CLI. The information set is attached; no DESIGN applies.
evals.expected_output: Use the app layout: header, download block with the DMG and checksum, the cask and a requirements line, light/dark screenshots planned from the released build, what you can do, getting started, permissions and privacy with the privacy policy link, support, release notes, building from source, Contributing and License, plus a short bundled CLI section; use supplied values unchanged and report a missing statement instead of inventing it.

evals.prompt: Lay out the README for example-team/parcel-ios, a closed-source iOS app on the App Store, in a private repository. The information set is attached; no DESIGN applies.
evals.expected_output: Use the same app layout with the official App Store badge artwork unchanged, the store screenshot set, and the supplied privacy statements and policy link; link the terms instead of build, Contributing and License sections; private visibility changes nothing else.

evals.prompt: Render our public and maintainer profiles from the supplied catalog, member input, pinned standard revision and DESIGN.
evals.expected_output: Use the TypeScript profile command for both layouts with one icon per row, the four required DESIGN component sizes, live badges/fallbacks and correct relative-link rebasing. Return byte checks and light/dark review scope. Member rendering requires --catalog-revision with the full standard commit; public rendering rejects it. Member input contains maintenance and repository operations only, including default_branch; CI badge URLs carry that branch and the online steward reports mismatches with GitHub.
